frame_row: Integrate source event packing, scope selection, counters, atomic snapshots and aggregate overflow interrupt.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_aggregate
(m_vlsit_pmu_aggregate)
blocks.function: Sum the same event indicator across active harts without discarding simultaneous occurrences.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_cluster_evt
(m_vlsit_pmu_cluster_evt)
blocks.function: Pack LLC single-bit indicators and CCU three-bit same-cycle occurrence counts into cluster event slots.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_cnt_bank
(m_vlsit_pmu_counter_bank)
blocks.function: Accumulate enabled event occurrence counts modulo the configured counter width and emit carry/overflow events.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_evt_sel
(m_vlsit_pmu_event_select)
blocks.function: Decode each software event ID and scope into an occurrence count for one counter.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_hart_evt
(m_vlsit_pmu_hart_evt)
blocks.function: Pack CVA6 and HPDcache source indicators into a stable per-hart catalog order.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_irq
(m_vlsit_pmu_irq)
blocks.function: Merge newly overflowing counters into retained raw causes and drive one aggregate level interrupt.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_snapshot
(m_vlsit_pmu_snapshot)
blocks.function: Capture every live counter atomically and expose stable software low/high read words.
